comments.note: The synthesis_generated_at repair comment in getProjectStatus (project-lifecycle.ts ~lines 424-437) is emitted in a separate withLock + writeRootIndex pass after the main healing write. This means a legacy ledger repair triggers three sequential lock acquisitions (main heal, pipeline ordering, repair comment). While correct and race-safe, a future consolidation into fewer lock acquisitions could reduce I/O on legacy-ledger first-reads. Non-blocking — the current approach is safe and the extra I/O only occurs once per legacy ledger.

The staleness check in pipeline.ts (line 379) uses lexicographic ISO 8601 comparison (depLastModified > pipeline.started_at). This works correctly for Z-suffixed timestamps of equal precision, which is the case in this codebase since now() always produces Z-terminated ISO strings. Worth noting in a comment for future maintainers — if timestamp formats ever diverge, a Date-based comparison would be safer.

Tests in project-lifecycle.test.ts use describe blocks labeled 'AC1', 'AC2', etc. that reference the plan's WP-007 acceptance criteria — but this is WP-008's test file. The AC labels actually refer to WP-007's internal plan steps (10-12), not WP-008's ACs. This is cosmetically confusing but not functionally incorrect.
The new root-index.test.ts file (20 tests) is clean, well-structured, and follows existing test patterns. Good use of safeParse for both positive and negative schema validation.
No observations on security or performance — all changes are test additions, schema field additions (optional/nullable), and safe refactors. No new attack surface introduced.
